name: av_company_overview
description:
Company profile and key ratios for one stock from Alpha Vantage (OVERVIEW).
Returns: one flat object of strings: Symbol, Name, Description, Exchange, Currency, Sector, Industry, MarketCapitalization, PERatio, PEGRatio, BookValue, DividendPerShare, DividendYield, EPS, ProfitMargin, Beta, 52WeekHigh, 52WeekLow, AnalystTargetPrice and more.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker).
Statements: av_income_statement, av_balance_sheet, av_cash_flow; EPS history: av_earnings. Other sources: yf_stock_info, openbb_equity_profile.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM"}
